{{% callout type="info" %}}
**Where to find it:** Applications & Components → Comma → Model Edit → `uCutout` (also on the Comma ribbon tab, Model Edit group)
{{% /callout %}}

Cuts one object out of others: pick a Beam or ContourPlate as the cutter, then the parts to cut.

**How to use:**

1.  Pick the cutter (a Beam or ContourPlate), then the target parts.
2.  Set the gaps and the branch options in the dialog before you click Apply.

| Option | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| **Name** | Name given to the created cutout. |
| **Side gap, End gap** | Metric numbers or arithmetic expressions (for example (2+3)\*4), or imperial feet/inch fractions per XS\_IMPERIAL\_INPUT when the dialog opens. Blank becomes zero; invalid input blocks Apply. |
| **Convex hull, Interpolation, High accuracy** | Choose how the cutter outline is built where applicable. |

Standard attributes load on opening: gaps with an absolute value above 9999 mm reset to 0 and negative flags reset to 0. Opening the dialog does not start a model operation.

**More details:**

-   Four typed branches support gaps, convex hull, interpolation and high accuracy where applicable.
-   Side/End gaps follow XS\_IMPERIAL\_INPUT when the dialog opens: metric numbers or arithmetic expressions (for example (2+3)\*4), imperial feet/inch fractions.
-   Reopen the dialog after changing input units.
-   Standard attributes load on opening: gaps with absolute value above 9999 mm reset to 0; negative flags reset to 0.

{{% callout type="warning" %}}
After an error, inspect possible partial changes and use Undo before retrying.
{{% /callout %}}
